dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: The selection is going pretty well... Ah, it's you, Honorary Knight. We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Selection"? What is this for?

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: We're looking for new Signals Officers.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: To ensure that we have the upper hand wherever we fight, and on when and where we fight, we must improve our ability to gather and act on battlefield intelligence.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: The role of Signals Officer was created fairly recently for this very purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Unlike the Outriders who move fast and light, Signal Officers stay back, hold position, and coordinate closely with the main troops.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Their alchemical recon gear is complex and demanding, and in terms of mobility, they sit somewhere between the light infantry and armored knights. This also means that they are more dependent on teamwork and coordination.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: According to our plan, once the relevant equipment and protocols are fully in place, Signals Officers will be assigned to every company. This ensures that capabilities are enhanced evenly and across the board.

choices.text: That sounds like quite a challenging role...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Yes. Overall, a Signals Officer is certainly held to more stringent standards than a regular knight.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Just a few years back, I was still concerned that the technical requirements were too tough and that few would be able to meet them...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: That's because only three individuals had managed to pass Leonore's initial screening, and in the end, I was the only one left standing by the time equipment testing was finally complete.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: And even though I've transitioned to the role of Intelligence Officer since, I'm still handling several matters related to the project.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Fortunately, the knights coming back from the expedition have shown themselves to be more capable with new concepts and complex mechanisms than anticipated. The plan is well on track.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Hopefully we can get the first group of Signals Officers in place before the next major battle. That will significantly increase our combat effectiveness.

choices.text: I'm guessing there's a lot to learn, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have you been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: I'm... Work-wise, I'm doing great.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: I've been recovering well, and have returned to work at full strength.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: I've got the Acting Grand Master and Captain Albedo to thank for that. Only Ematol and the knights who escorted me back then know exactly what happened to me.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Most of my fellow knights don't think less of me, and I'm able to get my work done without trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: I've also finished the outline for my book, "The Knight's Guide to the Prevention and Management of Psychic Disruption," which uses my misstep as a case study. I'll do my best to complete the full manuscript as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what's going on in the rest of your life?

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Ah, thanks for asking...

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: After my transfer here to Dornman Port, I rented out my house and moved into a new place here with Ematol.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: We have plenty of space in the living room for cat trees and cat toys, as well as for Dustball, the cat Ematol adopted.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Thanks to the two of them, I've been in a rather good mood lately...

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Leonore also comes by to see us every now and then. It does feel like my life is becoming more interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Say, if you're ever around and have the time, do drop by for some tea too. I'd love to pick your brain about possible future directions for the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll see you again some other time.

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Of course. I'll be here.
